description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/sectional_volume_1d/rules/growth_lr2m_D_bin_closed (number) and growth_lr2m_tracer_D_bin_closed (a volume-carried quantity) driven by problems/growth_sectional_lr2m_mms.esm: the sectional moments of dn/dt + d(lam v n)/dv = 0 on a geometric size grid over one doubling of volume, cell 1 growing (lam = +1) and cell 2 shrinking (lam = -1), from a compactly supported C2 bump whose exact section moments are closed form. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). The relative L2 errors of N and m at t = 0.2 fall as O(h^2) on the smooth part of the distribution; the limiter (triangle cut-backs, 1 % edge band) engages only in the sections at the edges of the support, whose share of the error falls with resolution, so the sweep starts at NBIN = 32 where the pairwise orders have settled near 2 (they are 1.3 at 16 -> 32). A dropped closed end, a wrong upwind branch or a mis-indexed edge leaves an O(1) error or a first-order one.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
